description:
Sulfur, charcoal and raw materials for any number of explosives. The sulfur calculator page (https://rust.wiki/calculators/sulfur): each explosive's crafting recipe resolved down
to raw materials (gunpowder and explosives broken into sulfur and charcoal - the raid calculator's own numbers).
`resources` is the shopping list (sulfur first), `to_farm` the sulfur ore (smelts 1:1) and wood to burn for the
charcoal, and with `sulfur` the `budget` table: how many rockets, C4, satchels... that sulfur makes. Every
explosive's `sulfur_each` is in the budget table and in /calculators/raid.

explosives.description: Comma-separated `shortname:count` explosives (names work too), e.g. rockets, C4, satchels, explosive ammo, beancans.

sulfur.description: Optional: the sulfur you have - how many of each standard explosive it makes.

name: calculate_sulfur
